meaning:
ἀν-έγκλητος, -ον
(ἀ-, ἐγκαλέω), [in LXX: 3Ma.5:31 * ;]
not to be called to account, unreprovable: 1Co.1:8, Col.1:22, 1Ti.3:10, Tit.1:6-7.†
SYN.: ἄμεμπτος, ἀνεπίλημπτος (see Tr., Syn., § ciii; Cremer, 742; MM, VGT, see word) (AS)
glosses: so that you will be blameless

renderings.bsb: so that you will be blameless

elsewhere.note: who will also confirm you until the end, blameless in the day of our Lord Jesus Christ.
yet now he has reconciled in the body of his flesh through death, to present you holy and without defect and blameless before him,
Let them also first be tested; then let them serve if they are blameless.
if anyone is blameless, the husband of one wife, having children who believe, who are not accused of loose or unruly behavior.
